sourceSentences: [0] Ahri doesn't win lane through damage. She wins through charm. Everything revolves around her E.
[0] Play around her charm cool down. It's long early, so use that window to step up and trade. Position around minions to block charm and make it harder for her to find angles.
[0] Her Q damage is mostly on the return. Side step it after the first hit to avoid the true damage burst. Once her ult is down, she has no mobility. She's a sitting duck.
[0] Twisted Fate's lane is his W. Once the card is used, he has no threat. Trade immediately after he uses pick a card since he has no way to fight back.
[0] Respect the gold card since it's guaranteed Q and empowered auto. His Q is easy to dodge on its own. Stay away from minions when he has a red card since it will splash onto you.
[0] At level six, spam ping that he has R and don't follow. Push the wave instead.
